intro.title: How to create a project
intro.description: Fill in six blocks in order. Each next block opens automatically once the previous one is complete.

step1.title: Project information
step1.description: Set the project name and assign the responsible user. The name can be changed later in settings.

bullets.1: The responsible user gets the project administrator role
bullets.2: The responsible user can be assigned later — this step is optional

step2.title: Document upload
step2.description: Upload files for analysis. PDF, DOCX, XLSX and other common formats are supported.

bullets.0: You can upload one or several files at once
bullets.1: Files are processed in the background — you can continue configuring
bullets.2: Additional files can be added later

step3.title: Playbook
step3.description: Choose a playbook — the set of checks to be applied to the documents. Only published versions are available.

bullets.0: Select a template first, then a version
bullets.1: The playbook defines the checks and the DD Grid
bullets.2: The playbook can be changed later in project settings

step4.title: Model profile
step4.description: Defines semantic search parameters and weights for hybrid retrieval. Optional step.

bullets.0: The profile applies to all project documents
bullets.1: If skipped, the default profile will be used
bullets.2: Can be changed later in settings

step5.title: Primary language
step5.description: The system automatically detects document languages. Once processing completes, select the primary analysis language.

bullets.0: Language detection runs in the background
bullets.1: The primary language defines the primary source for the checks
bullets.2: The selection becomes available once processing completes

step6.title: Launch analysis
step6.description: Select the check mode and launch the analysis. After launch you will be redirected to the project page.

bullets.0: Recommended mode — Playbook and document types
bullets.1: Force reclassify is useful after manual reclassification
bullets.2: Analysis progress is shown on the Overview tab
